commitSubject: Make the mask permit a type, not a bool
change: Mask permit is now a type only PermitMask can construct; call site cannot substitute its own comparison. Behaviour unchanged.
treeBuildFieldsProvenance: Observed at deploy time from the tree build, which the deployed artefact was byte-identical to.
freshness: plugin target rebuilt separately after the tests (xmake run builds only the test target); 945 assertions / 91 cases green

pdbLink.method: SECONDARY sanity check only - GUID is per-project and a PDB holds multiple info streams; byte identity is primary

symbolsContainer: PDB. C++ symbol names live in the .pdb, NOT the .dll - probing the DLL returns 0 for all of them and that 0 is not evidence the record is false. Counts must match EXACTLY, not >=.
mutationProof: float comparison back inside PermitMask fails test_overlay_alpha.cpp:56 and :68; forged-permit case pins that a default MaskPermit is never allowed.
whatThisDoesNotProve: Not cross-machine reproducible: no scratch-worktree rebuild of this commit was run, so this attests that ONE machine built these bytes from this revision, not that any machine would.
whyThisExists: A hash records the bytes shipped, not that they came from the intended source.
backupHolds: PRE-deployment files. backup DLL is deliberately NOT equal to dllSHA256; a mismatch means the backup worked.
whyDeployedCopyExists: Every EARLIER deploy survives the install being overwritten, because a later record's backup/ holds it. The newest deploy had no such record, so its bytes existed only in the live install - one Vortex/MO2 overwrite or reinstall from a hash alone. This directory is that copy. Copy the live DLL/PDB here at each deploy; never move this directory.
normalisedSource: Computed from the preserved DEPLOYED bytes, not from the backup in this directory.
mutationProofProvenance: Recorded at deploy time as: float comparison back inside PermitMask fails test_overlay_alpha.cpp:56 and :68; forged-permit case pins that a default MaskPermit is never allowed. Provenance added during a later audit; the proof text itself is unchanged.
